series.name: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 running + battery system LED indicators (Table 7-2 LED indicators)
series.notes: LED table for the S0 generation, distinct from SERIES 8 (LUNA2000-S1 indicators, which use white/capsule-shaped LEDs instead of green). Codes are LED state strings. Table key: long intervals = on 1s/off 1s, short intervals = on 0.2s/off 0.2s.

codes.code: Running LED1 Steady green + Running LED2 Steady green
aliases: Running LED1 Steady green + Running LED2 Steady green

title.ur: Operating mode (battery charge/discharge ho rahi hai)

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid green: the battery is charging from PV or discharging to the inverter.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid green: battery PV se charge ho rahi hai ya inverter ko discharge kar rahi hai.

causes.ur: Normal charge ya discharge chal raha hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; cross-check the current flow direction in the app if you suspect reverse power.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi; reverse power ka shak ho to app mein current flow direction cross-check karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Table 7-2 LED indicators

meaning.en: Both running LEDs off - the internal auxiliary supply and DC-DC converter are not working.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs off - internal auxiliary supply aur DC-DC converter kaam nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: Normal hibernation after a period with no PV and no load.
causes.ur: PV aur load ke ghanton baad normal hibernation.

solutions.en: Expect LEDs to come on when PV voltage returns above the wake threshold.
solutions.ur: PV voltage wake threshold se upar aate hi LEDs on hone ki umeed karein.

solutions.en: If the pack should be operating and both LEDs stay off, check PV generation and the battery DC switch.
solutions.ur: Agar pack ko chalna chahiye lekin dono LEDs off rahen to PV generation aur battery DC switch check karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Table 7-2 LED indicators

title.ur: Power control module environment alarm (battery ke around ka masla)

meaning.en: Running LED1 blinking fast red marks an environmental alarm on the power control module - usually temperature or enclosure related.
meaning.ur: Running LED1 fast red blink power control module ka environmental alarm batata hai - aam tor par temperature ya enclosure se related.

causes.en: Module overtemperature or undertemperature alarm such as 3002 or 3009.
causes.ur: Module overtemperature ya undertemperature alarm, maslan 3002 ya 3009.

causes.en: Enclosure moisture or condensation causing a module environmental trip.
causes.ur: Enclosure mein nami ya condensation se module environmental trip hua hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app - fast red on the module LED maps to 3002/3008/3009 temperature alarms.
solutions.ur: App mein numeric alarm padhein - module LED ka fast red 3002/3008/3009 temperature alarms se map hota hai.

solutions.en: Measure temperature at the module and check the cabinet for condensation or a blocked air path.
solutions.ur: Module ka temperature measure karein aur cabinet mein condensation ya blocked air path check karein.

solutions.en: If temperature is normal, inspect for water ingress at gland entries and dry the enclosure before restart.
solutions.ur: Agar temperature normal hai to gland entries par paani ka dakhil check karke enclosure sukha karein, phir restart karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Running LED1 blinking red fast (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

title.ur: Battery expansion module environment alarm (pack ka masla)

meaning.en: Running LED2 blinking fast red marks an environmental alarm on the battery expansion module (pack).
meaning.ur: Running LED2 fast red blink battery expansion module (pack) ka environmental alarm batata hai.

causes.en: Expansion pack overtemperature or low temperature alarm such as 3008 or 3009.
causes.ur: Expansion pack overtemperature ya low temperature alarm, maslan 3008 ya 3009.

causes.en: Pack installed in a spot with no airflow, or ambient outside the pack's operating window.
causes.ur: Pack aise jagah lagi jahan airflow nahi, ya ambient pack ke operating window se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app and note which pack position is flagged.
solutions.ur: App mein numeric alarm padhein aur note karein ke kaun si pack position flag hai.

solutions.en: Measure that pack's surface temperature with a contact thermometer and compare to the other packs.
solutions.ur: Us pack ka surface temperature contact thermometer se measure karke baaki packs se compare karein.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation and clearances; if only one pack runs hot, suspect that pack and escalate.
solutions.ur: Ventilation aur clearance behtar karein; agar sirf ek pack garm ho to us pack par shak karke escalate karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Running LED2 blinking red fast (on 0.2s, off 0.2s)

meaning.en: Running LED1 solid red: the manual states the power control module is faulty.
meaning.ur: Running LED1 solid red: manual ke mutabiq power control module faulty hai.

causes.en: Internal circuit fault in the power control module, e.g. alarm 3001 Abnormal battery power control module.
causes.ur: Power control module ka internal circuit fault, maslan alarm 3001 Abnormal battery power control module.

causes.en: Fuse blown in the module, e.g. alarm 3003.
causes.ur: Module ka fuse udd gaya, maslan alarm 3003.

solutions.en: Get the numeric alarm from the app; steady red is a symptom, the app gives the cause.
solutions.ur: App se numeric alarm lein; steady red symptom hai, app wajah batata hai.

solutions.en: Power off in the manual sequence and wait 5 minutes before inspecting the module.
solutions.ur: Manual sequence se band karein aur module inspect karne se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If 3003 is shown, check the fuse rating before fitting a replacement; a wrong rating is a fire risk.
solutions.ur: Agar 3003 aaye to replacement lagane se pehle fuse rating check karein; galat rating aag ka khatra hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Table 7-2 LED indicators

meaning.en: Running LED2 solid red: the manual states the battery expansion module is faulty.
meaning.ur: Running LED2 solid red: manual ke mutabiq battery expansion module faulty hai.

causes.en: Internal circuit fault in the expansion pack, e.g. alarm 3006 Abnormal battery expansion module.
causes.ur: Expansion pack ka internal circuit fault, maslan alarm 3006 Abnormal battery expansion module.

causes.en: Expansion module cable disconnected, e.g. alarm 3007.
causes.ur: Expansion module ka cable disconnect hai, maslan alarm 3007.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app and identify the faulty pack position.
solutions.ur: App mein numeric alarm padhein aur faulty pack ki position pehchan lein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, reseat every daisy-chain connector between the power control module and packs.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke power control module aur packs ke darmiyan har daisy-chain connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, isolate the suspect pack from the chain and escalate for module replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm bana rahe to shak ke paksh wali pack ko chain se isolate karke module replacement ke liye escalate karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Table 7-2 LED indicators

meaning.en: The green bars on the circular battery system indicator show state of charge; each bar is 10%.
meaning.ur: Circular battery system indicator ke green bars state of charge dikhate hain; har bar 10% hai.

causes.en: Normal SOC display; the count of lit bars equals the state of charge.
causes.ur: Normal SOC display; lit bars ki tadaad state of charge ke barabar hoti hai.

solutions.en: Read SOC from this indicator when the app is offline; treat 3 bars or fewer as a call to check load and shading.
solutions.ur: App offline ho to is indicator se SOC padhein; 3 bars ya us se kam ko load aur shading check karne ka signal samajhein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Table 7-2 LED indicators

title.en: Number of faulty expansion modules shown
title.ur: Faulty expansion modules ki tadaad (pehle teen bars)

meaning.en: The first three bars are solid red, and the number of lit bars equals the number of faulty battery expansion modules.
meaning.ur: Pehle teen bars solid red hain, aur lit bars ki tadaad faulty battery expansion modules ki tadaad ke barabar hai.

causes.en: One or more battery expansion modules have faulted.
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada battery expansion modules fault ho gaye hain.

causes.en: A pack is not communicating after a cable or connector fault.
causes.ur: Cable ya connector fault ke baad pack communicate nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Count the red bars to know how many packs are affected, then match that to the app's pack list.
solutions.ur: Red bars gin lein taake pata chale kitne packs affected hain, phir usay app ke pack list se match karein.

solutions.en: Isolate DC and reseat the daisy-chain connectors to clear a high-resistance comms fault.
solutions.ur: DC isolate karke daisy-chain connectors dobara laga dein taake high-resistance comms fault clear ho.

solutions.en: If a count persists, that pack has failed internally - plan module replacement, not just a cable fix.
solutions.ur: Agar count bana rahe to us pack mein internal failure hai - sirf cable fix nahi, module replacement plan karein.
